company.name: Attune
company.shortDescription: Financial Health Analytics for Credit Unions
company.description:
We see a world where every financial institution makes financial health a KPI. 

Today, we help credit unions operate through the lens of financial health:
 - Set strategic plans at the board level with financial health at the core of purpose, vision, and mission
 - Market to prospects based on their unique financial health needs and your unique solutions
 - Develop your product roadmap based on what’s going to drive the largest improvement in member financial health
 - Create member experiences designed to uplift financial health at every turn - even when denying a loan
 - Build your compensation and benefits around employee financial health: when you take care of your employees, your employees take care of your members, and your members take care of the credit union
 - Help your SEGs help their employees with employee financial health to accelerate your mission and your business development

We are your one-stop shop for making financial health and wellbeing for all actionable at every level, from financial service representatives to board members.

productsAndServices.description: A platform for credit unions and employers that connects financial health diagnosis, recommendations, program delivery, outcome measurement, and organizational reporting.
productsAndServices.name: FinHealth Workflow™

productsAndServices.description: A validated financial health assessment and scoring system measuring spending, saving, borrowing, and planning through an overall score and pillar-level results.
productsAndServices.name: FinHealth Score® Assessment and Scoring Engine

productsAndServices.description: Developer-focused infrastructure that lets financial-services and insurance companies embed financial health diagnosis, outcome tracking, and benchmarking into their products through APIs and other integration methods.
productsAndServices.name: Enterprise FinHealth Infrastructure

productsAndServices.description: Analytical and research services that measure changes in financial health, compare populations with benchmarks, and produce leadership-ready evidence about program effectiveness.
productsAndServices.name: Financial Health Outcomes, Benchmarking, and Reporting Services

productsAndServices.description: Implementation support for configuring financial health assessments, recommendations, data connections, and reporting across an organization’s existing programs and systems.
productsAndServices.name: Financial Health Program Implementation and Integration Services
